GLOBAL_ACCOUNT_ENTRY.definition: Everything reachable before an authenticated user has a resolved Organization membership: public marketing, authentication, invitation acceptance, and the pre-tenant organization-creation step.
GLOBAL_ACCOUNT_ENTRY.not: not an authorization boundary by itself; requireAuth()/requireOrganizationAccess() remain the actual server-side gates

ORGANIZATION.definition: The tenant-scoped context. Everything under an existing Organization + membership: workspace home, multi-project management, portfolio, trust center, and organization administration, including the post-provisioning calibration step.
ORGANIZATION.invariant_preserved: Organization is tenant root. CommercialAccount != Organization (RE-U0 Q6) — billing surfaces here remain organization-scoped in current implementation; a future CommercialAccount governing relationship across organizations is a target-architecture reservation, not implemented in this delta.

PROJECT.definition: A single SROI project within an Organization: its Measure pipeline, its reports, and its contextual Stella actions.
PROJECT.not: not a separate authorization root — project access is still Organization-membership-scoped

onboarding_surface_disposition.question: Are /app/onboarding and /app/organization/onboarding duplicated semantics or a genuine two-phase separation?

app_onboarding.precondition: requireAuth(); redirects to /app/dashboard if getCurrentMembership() already resolves
app_onboarding.function: creates the Organization row itself (name, slug, legalName, country, sector) via createFirstOrganization, gated by lib/admin/signup-allowlist.ts (RE-U0 Q4)
app_onboarding.phase: PRE_TENANT — organization does not exist yet

app_organization_onboarding.precondition: requireOrganizationAccess() inside completeOnboarding (app/actions/onboarding.ts) — an Organization and membership already exist
app_organization_onboarding.function: sets operating parameters (country, sector, baseCurrency) and flips organizations.onboardingCompleted (default false) to true
app_organization_onboarding.enforcement: components/auth/OnboardingCheck.tsx, mounted in app/app/layout.tsx, hard-redirects every /app/** request to this route while onboardingCompleted is false, and away from it once true
app_organization_onboarding.phase: POST_PROVISIONING — organization exists, is not yet operationally calibrated

onboarding_surface_disposition.rationale: The repository behavior actually supports the hypothesized split: phase 1 (tenant does not exist, allowlist-gated creation) is structurally distinct from phase 2 (tenant exists, mandatory calibration enforced by a layout-level redirect guard). This is grounded in code (requireAuth+no-membership vs requireOrganizationAccess+existing-membership, plus the OnboardingCheck enforcement path), not asserted from naming similarity.
onboarding_surface_disposition.residual_debt: Both routes are colloquially named 'onboarding', which is mildly confusable in code/docs despite being semantically distinct at runtime. Recorded as a LOW-severity naming-clarity item (see ia_consolidation_debts[2]), not a route consolidation.

role_authorization_ia.statement: IA is not authorization. Server-side/RLS enforcement (lib/auth/roles.ts six-role hierarchy, lib/auth/permissions.ts twenty canX predicates, RLS policies) is untouched by this artifact and remains the sole authorization boundary.
role_authorization_ia.measured_current_state: Primary navigation is role-blind: NAV_LINKS renders identically for all six roles; privileged actions (edit settings, invite members, admin billing) are gated in-page (hasRole/ROLES checks) and server-side, not by hiding nav entries.
role_authorization_ia.future_implication_for_u4_u7: Role-aware discoverability (e.g. narrowing Billing/Settings visibility for lower-privilege roles) is a legitimate future IA/UX improvement, but MUST remain additive to existing RLS/server checks, never a substitute for them.

u4_journey_implications: Self-service signup/autoprovisioning journey design (Q4) must build on top of the confirmed two-phase onboarding (provisioning -> setup), not replace or merge its phases.
U1-F04 dead remediation-link repair remains a separate, already-named next gate (RE_U1_F04_REMEDIATION_LINK_REPAIR) and is not resolved by this IA delta.
Role-aware nav discoverability is deferred to U4/U7 and must not weaken existing authorization.
Evaluate and Portfolio-aggregation journeys stay journey-reserved, not journey-implemented, until Wave 3 / Wave 5-6 land respectively.
